newsitem.title: BURKINA FASO: African first ladies pledge to back child rights.
newsitem.headline: African first ladies pledge to back child rights.

text.p: The wives of the presidents of the African states of Burkina Faso, Congo, Mali and Niger have pledged to work to promote children's rights and the education of girls.

The four wives made the pledge on Friday at the end of a five-day conference in Burkina Faso organised with the help of the U.N. and attended by 300 people, including 15 African ministers responsible for primary education or child protection.
Chantal Compaore, wife of Burkina Faso's president, and Anne Aymone Giscard d'Estaing, wife of the former French president, organised the meeting.
The next such meeting is due to take place in Colombia.
